card.name: Start of a word after a product name
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word or number that follows a brand or company name, as in 'Chiesi Farm', 'Acthar Gel Multi', 'Lilly 3 mL'. It also fires on 'DIS' at the start of an all-caps 'DISCARD'.

modes.label: Company or brand name continuation
modes.description: The next piece after a company or product name, where the word is only partly written.

modes.label: Product size or form
modes.description: A number or label word after Lilly or a product name, before a unit or dose form.

modes.label: All-caps instruction start
modes.description: The first piece of an all-caps discard instruction after a sentence ends.
modes.example: The pH of the resultant solution is 1.0 to 3.0.<< DIS>>CARD UNUSED SOLUTIONS.

card.writes: It adds odd rare word pieces and pushes down 'food' words, so there is no clear meaning.
card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a word right after a brand or company name in a drug label.
